{"id":2055587675,"question_id":3919,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 weeks, 5 days","timestamp":1783161170,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"425 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2055587675/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Network Recovery Pathways","memory":"371.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int n;\n    using ll = long long;\n    using pi = pair<ll,int>;\n\n    unordered_map<int , vector<pi>>adj;\n    vector<ll>pathcosts;\n\n    bool DijkstraAlgo(int dest , ll midvalue , ll k)\n    {\n        vector<ll>dist(n , LLONG_MAX);\n        dist[0] = 0;\n        priority_queue<pi , vector<pi> , greater<pi>>pq;\n\n        pq.push({0 , 0});\n        while(!pq.empty())\n        {\n            auto[cost , node] = pq.top();\n            pq.pop();\n\n            if(dist[node] < cost) continue;\n            if(cost > k) return false;\n            if(node == dest) return true;\n\n            for(auto nbr : adj[node])\n            {\n                auto[nbrcost , nbrnode] = nbr;\n                if(nbrcost < midvalue) continue;\n\n                if(nbrcost + cost < dist[nbrnode])\n                {\n                    dist[nbrnode] = cost + nbrcost;\n                    pq.push({dist[nbrnode] , nbrnode});\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    int findMaxPathScore(vector<vector<int>>& edges, vector<bool>& online, long long k) {\n        n = online.size();\n        for(auto it : edges)\n        {\n            int u = it[0];\n            int v = it[1];\n            ll cost = it[2];\n\n            if(online[u] and online[v]) adj[u].push_back({cost , v});\n            pathcosts.push_back(cost);\n        }\n\n        sort(begin(pathcosts) , end(pathcosts));\n        pathcosts.erase(unique(begin(pathcosts) , end(pathcosts)) , end(pathcosts));\n\n        int st = 0;\n        int end = pathcosts.size()-1;\n\n        ll ans = -1;\n\n        while(st <= end)\n        {\n            int mid = st + (end - st)/2;\n            if(DijkstraAlgo(n-1 , pathcosts[mid] , k))\n            {\n                ans = mid;\n                st = mid + 1;\n            }\n            else end = mid - 1;\n        }\n\n        return ans == -1 ? -1 : (int)pathcosts[ans];\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"network-recovery-pathways","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2291}
